# webcafe.africa

> webcafe.africa is a software studio in Nairobi, Kenya that designs and builds websites, web apps and integrations that move businesses forward. Tagline: "Built to move."

## Services

- Websites: personal portfolios and branding, business websites, e-commerce stores.
- Web apps: custom CRM and ERP systems, point of sale, events and ticketing, productivity tools.
- Integrations: payment gateways (mobile money, cards, bank transfers), tax management and e-invoicing, accounting software, SMS and email, third-party APIs.

## How a project works

1. Inquiry: the client fills out the inquiry form; if it is a good fit, a consultation is booked.
2. Proposal: scope, timeline and cost; a 50% deposit secures a spot in the production schedule.
3. Production: built to the agreed timeline with regular updates and chances for feedback.
4. Delivery: handover of the finished product, plus training and support.

## Selected work

- [TableNest](https://www.tablenest.site): restaurant management platform for locations, menus, reservations, reviews and restaurant websites.
- [Spotlit](https://spotlit-seven.vercel.app): creator portfolio and media kit page with a brand inquiry inbox.
